reviewer: storage_review; forge UI and CSS authored by other collaborators
method: Read-only inspection of supplied 1366×768 and 390×844 screenshots.
Read-only inspection of src/forge.css, forge markup/forecast in src/views.js and README release-scope statements.
Checked forge selector usage in source; no browser, test suite or code mutation performed for this UI review.

observations.result: Five slot targets, item heading, actual item-stat range, all six face outcomes and the primary 43-gold action are visible without observed overlap or horizontal clipping. Secondary details continue below the internal viewport.

Five tabs fit; six outcomes reflow to three columns by two rows. The primary action, payment balance and native details summary are visible without observed horizontal overflow in the supplied screenshot.

The shown level-1 +0 armor quotes item HP 40 → 40–44 and defense 3 → 3. Faces 1–2 retain HP 40; faces 3–6 show HP 44. Zero-rounded defense gain is explicitly unchanged. The 43-gold cost and visible 99,957 balance agree with the 100,000 gold shown. The item-stat qualification and unchanged fixed-trait rules remain explicit in the template.

Page/shell reflow overrides are gated by .game-shell[data-scene="forge"] or html/body :has that forge scene. Other bare forge-specific component classes are used only by the forge markup in the reviewed source; no known selector effect outside forge was found.

scrollReachability.desktopSource: The forge target declares overflow-y:auto and direct children flex-shrink:0, so below-fold notes/details remain part of a scrollable target rather than being shrunk away.
scrollReachability.desktopScreenshot: The primary action is visible; the screenshot alone cannot demonstrate wheel/keyboard scroll or the complete lower content.
scrollReachability.parentReportedRuntimeEvidence: Root explicitly reported vertical scroll reachability and actual action clicks with all five slot saves completed. This reviewer did not repeat those browser operations.
scrollReachability.narrowScreenshot: The supplied 390 screenshot shows the primary action and balance. Source permits forge-page auto height/scroll; content beyond the captured fold was not interactively rechecked here.

limitations: This is a bounded static cross-review, not an independent browser interaction, persistence, keyboard, screen-reader or physical-touch certification.
No claims are made about every equipment state, zoom level or viewport from two screenshots.
The game remains desktop-first; the forge-specific narrow reflow does not establish global phone support.
No renderer timing or performance conclusion is derived from these screenshots.
